title: Listening Calendar
description: A year of listening drawn as a contribution calendar where every day is a tiny tile of the album you played most. Sweep across it and a lens swells the days under the pointer while a loupe opens that day's songs, times and minutes; click to pin it.
intent: A heatmap where the heat is the artwork: tile size and colour carry how much you listened, and a fisheye lens plus loupe make 365 tiny covers readable without leaving the year view.
